items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025

ctx.x: Artie some years ago said, “You know, remember how dumb we used to think some of those songs were? Today they sound like Mozart.”

Well yes, I’m fascinated, I love just the arrangements that go into these things. And there’s a lot to be learned from that. When you created those commercials a lot of times they were a minute long, sometimes more, sometimes less. But what goes through your head now when you watch television and they fit like three commercials in like in twenty seconds?
